description: Draw a new diagram frame from text, placed right of what the page already holds (or at `at`). One undo step. To change a diagram that exists, use update_diagram with its frameId instead of drawing another.

at.description: Top-left corner of the new frame in page coordinates; omit to place it beside what is there.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

dsl.description: OpenFlow DSL source. Mermaid, Structurizr DSL and D2 are accepted too: they convert first, and the result carries `converted.dsl` (keep editing that) and `converted.losses`. Call get_syntax when unsure. A node whose tech: or label names a technology (Postgres, React, S3) gets its icon automatically; `icon: none` opts one node out, `icons: off` the whole diagram.

pageId.description: Page to draw on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

palette.description: Diagram palette; defaults to the one the DSL names (`appearance:`), else pastel.

name: create_diagram
title: Create diagram
